observations: Two manual treadle sewing machine stands.
Each stand consists of a cast iron frame with a foot pedal, flywheel, and a wooden tabletop.
The tabletops have cutouts designed for drop-in sewing machine heads.
One tabletop has a blue and grey marbled laminate finish (Photo 2).
One tabletop has a brown wood-grain laminate finish (Photo 3).
The brand name 'SUMO PREMIUM' is cast into the metal foot pedals (Photo 2, Photo 3).
The stands appear to be in new or refurbished condition with fresh paint on the metalwork.

claims.evidence: The photos show cast iron treadle legs typically used for manual sewing machines, often referred to as 'weaving' machines (overlockers) in local markets.

risks.risk: Treadle mechanism may be seized or not rotate smoothly.
risks.proof: A video showing the flywheel rotating freely when the pedal is pumped.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring mechanical repair or lubrication.

risks.proof: A photo showing the belt installed around the flywheel and through the table holes.

risks.risk: Tabletop material may be low-quality particle board prone to swelling.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the side edges and underside of the wooden tops.
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard grade laminate board.

proof_requests: Video of the treadle mechanism in motion to confirm smooth operation.
Confirmation if the drive belt is included for each stand.
Clearer photos of the tabletop edges to check for laminate peeling or board swelling.
response.reason: The items are clearly identified as Sumo Premium treadle stands. While mechanical smoothness is unverified, they can be priced at a base functional value for this model in the local market.
